coaches.name: Cliff Meredith
coaches.summary: Cliff Meredith is a member of the Mid-Valley USBC Hall of Fame. He bowled in college for Linn-Benton Community College and Oregon State University, including USBC sectional competition, and he coached the Central Oregon Community College team while working at Sun Mountain Lanes. He has led youth programs in the Albany area, coached South Albany High School bowling for three years, and served eight years as the Oregon State USBC high school manager. He has also worked with the University of Oregon and Oregon State University on their college bowling programs. He is a USBC registered volunteer and has completed SafeSport certification. He wants bowling to feel welcoming both for athletes who compete and for those who bowl because they enjoy it.

coaches.name: Chris Breshears
coaches.summary: Chris Breshears is from Albany and has been bowling since 1994, starting in the youth program at B & D Bowl. He has competed across the country, bowled for West Albany High School, and in 1998 helped restart the high school program while he was still a bowler. After graduation he coached the boys’ and girls’ teams for several years and coached youth leagues in the Albany area. He is certified in bowling ball drilling and fitting. His focus is giving back to young bowlers in the community.
